images.title: Which thousand is nearer
images.purpose: Show on a number line why 6,72,85,183 rounds to the nearest thousand 6,72,85,000.
images.composition: A single horizontal number line across the middle with three ticks and one marked point; white space above and below.
exact_structure: A horizontal grey #6B7280 number line with three equally spaced ticks labelled left to right '6,72,85,000', '6,72,85,500', '6,72,86,000'.
A reddish purple #CC79A7 dot at 6,72,85,183, between the first and second tick, about a third of the way from the left tick to the middle tick, labelled above '6,72,85,183'.
A teal #0072B2 arrow from the dot to the left tick 6,72,85,000, with the caption below the line 'Nearest thousand'.
The right tick 6,72,86,000 is drawn in grey, not highlighted; the middle tick is marked with a small label 'halfway'.
rejection: dot placed beyond the halfway tick
any tick value altered or digits misgrouped
images.takeaway: Because 183 is less than the halfway 500, the number rounds down to 6,72,85,000.
images.description: A number line from 6,72,85,000 to 6,72,86,000 with 6,72,85,183 closer to the left end and an arrow to it.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Check which end the dot is closer to, then compare it with the halfway mark.

image_decisions.why: Rounding to the nearest thousand is clearest as a position on a number line.
